pages.text: The $(item)Packager/$ packages items into $(l:core/package)Recipe Packages/$, which then can be unpackaged in an $(l:core/unpackager)Unpackager/$.$(p)This machine requires power.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)Packager/$, put an encoded $(l:core/recipe_holder)Package Recipe Holder/$ inside. The machine will then be able to create $(l:core/package)Recipe Packages/$ for the encoded recipes. Created packages will be ejected into adjacent inventories.$(p)You may extract inputs out from the top side.

pages.title: Modes
pages.text: $(thing)Require Exact/$: Make the first package that exactly matches inventory contents.$(p)$(thing)Require Disjoint/$: Checks if packages have no overlap and make the package that can be made from inventory contents, otherwise fallback to $(thing)Require Exact/$.$(p)$(thing)First Match/$: Make the first package that can be made from inventory contents.

pages.title: Settings Cloning
pages.text: Using the $(l:core/settings_cloner)Packaging Settings Cloner/$, you can copy and paste the mode setting and the current available recipes.$(p)To paste recipes, the target $(item)Packager/$ should not have recipes, and you must have an empty $(l:core/recipe_holder)Package Recipe Holder/$ in your inventory.

pages.title: AE2 Integration
pages.text: The $(item)Packager/$ can be connected to an $(thing)ME Network/$, requiring a channel.$(p)It will extract power to use, provide packaging as autocrafting, and instead eject created $(l:core/package)Recipe Packages/$ into the network.
